sub_questions.question: What happens once the Sandbox workspace's 200 credits run out — does the app just stop working?

claims.claim: Model calls that rely on Dify-hosted credits stop working once the Sandbox credits are used up.
claims.guide_evidence: Once a workspace's credits are used up, model calls on Dify-hosted credits stop working

claims.claim: Sandbox credits do not reset, unlike paid plans.
claims.guide_evidence: waits for the next monthly credit reset (paid plans) — Sandbox credits do not reset

claims.claim: Connecting your own provider API key keeps the app running, with calls billed directly by the provider instead of drawing Dify credits.
claims.guide_evidence: calls to that provider's models are billed directly by the provider and no longer draw down the workspace's Dify message credits

claims.claim: Upgrading to Professional gives 5,000 credits per month that renew each billing cycle.
An in-app banner appears when the workspace is down to its last 20 credits.

evaluation.rationale: Most of the answer is grounded in the guide. That covers calls on Dify-hosted credits stopping, Sandbox credits not resetting, bring-your-own-key billing, and Professional's 5,000 monthly credits. The low-credit banner at 20 credits is a made-up product feature that the guide never mentions. The customer could count on that warning and then be caught off guard when the credits run out, so the answer shouldn't go out as written.
